blocks.text: The Office of the Ombudsman said on Monday that a Sandiganbayan ruling rejecting Sen. Jinggoy Estrada’s bid to lift his 90-day preventive suspension affirmed its position that the cases before the anti-graft court’s Fifth Division are separate from the graft case pending before its Second Division.
